name: m5-backend-ceiling
description: What is the most a stack map scheme could save? `readFrames`, `readMaxs` and `readNone` write the same nodes, read back from the classfiles, with ASM computing frames, given perfect frames, and given frames and maximums. `branchFreeFrames` and `branchFreeMaxs` do that for only the methods with no jump, switch or handler, so their difference is what frame computation costs methods that need no frames. `phase`, `codegen` and `write` put those in proportion.
Oracle frames cost nothing to produce here, so this is a ceiling and not a design. Upstream `2.13.x` at `c84dea8aa7`, built with the release optimizer settings; patched JDK 26, 8G heap.
